title: Make Tmux the OS
summary: This article explores the concept of using Tmux (a terminal multiplexer) as the primary user interface for a minimalist, keyboard-driven operating system experience, detailing the author's dream OS configuration.
problem_solved: Provides an alternative to traditional GUI-heavy operating systems for power users seeking a distraction-free, highly efficient terminal-centric workflow.
why_valuable: Offers practical insights for developers and sysadmins looking to maximize productivity through a fully customizable, keyboard-driven computing environment.
